rules-note: P and D business strikes only (plus W for the 2019-2020 America the Beautiful designs): no S coins of any kind (proof, silver proof, Uncirculated or Enhanced uncirculated), no silver bullion, no privy-mark specials. Every coin carries its mint mark. variety is the design name as displayed in the source. Mintages come only from the saved source; null where it gives no figure. Release order: designs in source order, then P, D (then W). isKeyDate is false throughout; no images. This file: the six 2009 District of Columbia and US Territories tables of "Washington quarter mintage figures" (one table per design); proof and silver proof S rows skipped. variety is the territory as named in the table caption.
name: DC and US Territories Quarters
